actions.description: The user stories are code-shaped with real, testable acceptance criteria, correctly distinguish code-shaped stories from documentation-only items rather than forcing everything into a Story template, and are traceable to their BRD/FDD/ADR -- approve them

The user stories have a fundamental, unfixed flaw -- e.g. acceptance criteria that cannot actually be contract-tested, or a story forced into a shape the underlying work does not have -- reject them outright
The user stories need a real change before they can be judged -- distinct from a named, deliberately out-of-scope follow-on item already scoped correctly

metadata.decision_context: Stage 6 recommendation on whether Epic 23 user stories are ready for human approval

complexity_profile.rationale: Baseline governance gates (approve-charter, approve-adr, approve-project-pillars, etc.) require explicit human sign-off per ADR-021.
